usedFor: CTM tracks phone calls, and Google Drive gets a copy of a file through “Copy a File” when “Call Ends”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Ends” in CTM, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A finished call is a natural point to start a file, and the action copies one into a chosen folder.

watchOut: “Call Ends” runs after every call, so “Copy a File” makes one copy per call unless you filter first.
